title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Write-Off Rules
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — write-off of an unrecovered amount.**

An unrecovered amount is written off without recourse to the worker in two cases:

1. a shortfall that cannot be carried because its carry chain has reached the tier's carryforward count is written off with reason carryforward limit reached; and
2. a shortfall with reason employment ended, which is never carried, is written off with reason employment ended.

**Waiting period.** A write-off is booked only after the tier's write-off wait in calendar days has passed since the payday of the shortfall it writes off. Calendar days are counted from the day after that payday, so the earliest write-off date is the payday plus the number of days.

*Boundary (hypothetical, 30-day wait, shortfall payday 9 May):* 8 June is the payday plus 30 days and is the earliest write-off date; a write-off on 7 June is too early.

**Once only.** A shortfall is written off at most once.

**The entry.** The write-off points to its shortfall, carries the shortfall's payday, and its amount is the shortfall amount less any card autorecovery or voluntary payment collected against that payday after the shortfall was booked.

*Hypothetical amount:* a shortfall of 86.40 USD, after which a card autorecovery of 30.00 USD and a voluntary payment of 6.40 USD were collected against the same payday, is written off at 50.00 USD.

**Protections.** A written-off amount is never reported to a credit bureau, sold, placed with a collector, or charged interest or fees, and it is never re-billed to the worker.

**Tier effect.** *(The sentence that follows is no longer in force for any review of the plan's tier; the tier review and the missed-recovery review each state how a write-off bears on the tier.)* When the tier carries a write-off reset, the plan returns to Paystride Access Starter at the next level review.

superseded_clauses: when writeoff_resets_to_starter is true the plan returns to Paystride Access Starter at the next level review.
